summary: This bill amends Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972 to define "female," "male," and "sex" based on biological reproductive systems and to clarify that educational institutions can maintain sex-segregated spaces and programs without losing federal funding.

scores.thoughts: This bill defines 'female' and 'male' based on reproductive systems and 'sex' as biologically determined, and explicitly allows for sex-segregated spaces and programs in educational institutions under Title IX. This directly impacts transgender and gender non-conforming individuals by potentially excluding them from spaces aligning with their gender identity, thus limiting their legal protections and inclusion.
